scenarios.title: A｜不要某种配料
scenarios.setting: 在“提出饮食要求”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“不要某种配料”。

turns.prompt: 你想提出希望调整菜品配料的需求，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could I have this without onions, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I have this without onions, please?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: Could you leave out the onions?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you leave out the onions?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Is it possible to make this without onions?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is it possible to make this without onions?
feedback.explanation: 先问是否有可能安排，适合需要对方查看余位或规则的请求，语气比直接要求更柔和。

choices.text: I’d like this, but without the onions.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like this, but without the onions.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I don’t want onion inside.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Could I have this without onions, please?
feedback.explanation: 去掉洋葱可说“without onions”；“I don’t want onion inside”能懂，但搭配不如点单常用说法简洁。

turns.text: Sure. We can leave them out.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Perfect, thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect, thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Great. Everything else is fine.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Everything else is fine.
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。

choices.text: Could you also put the sauce on the side?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you also put the sauce on the side?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

scenarios.title: B｜食物过敏
scenarios.setting: 在“提出饮食要求”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“食物过敏”。

turns.prompt: 你想说明过敏方面的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: I have a peanut allergy. Does this dish contain any peanuts?

feedback.naturalExpression: I have a peanut allergy. Does this dish contain any peanuts?
feedback.explanation: 核实某项内容是否包含在内，能避免双方对配料、配件或费用作不同假设。

choices.text: I’m allergic to peanuts. Is this safe for me to eat?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m allergic to peanuts. Is this safe for me to eat?
feedback.explanation: “allergic to”明确表示对某物过敏，与不喜欢或不想吃不同。

choices.text: Does this contain peanuts or peanut oil?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does this contain peanuts or peanut oil?
feedback.explanation: 核实某项内容是否包含在内，能避免双方对配料、配件或费用作不同假设。

choices.text: Could you check whether there are any peanuts in this dish?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check whether there are any peanuts in this dish?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I can’t eat peanuts.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I have a peanut allergy. Does this dish contain any peanuts?
feedback.explanation: “can’t eat”可能只是饮食限制；若确实过敏，应明确说“I’m allergic to peanuts”，避免误会。

turns.text: The dish itself doesn’t contain peanuts, but I’ll check with the kitchen.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. I’d appreciate that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I’d appreciate that.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

choices.text: Could you also check whether it’s prepared with any peanut products?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you also check whether it’s prepared with any peanut products?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Please let them know that it’s an allergy.

feedback.naturalExpression: Please let them know that it’s an allergy.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: A small amount is fine.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I’d appreciate that.
feedback.explanation: 这句表示能接受少量花生；如果实际是过敏，就改变了重要信息，应准确说明过敏情况。

turns.text: I’ve checked with the kitchen. This particular dish contains no peanuts, but other dishes containing peanuts are prepared in the kitchen.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you for letting me know.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you for letting me know.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Is there another dish you’d recommend given my allergy?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there another dish you’d recommend given my allergy?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Could you tell me which dishes would be safer options?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you tell me which dishes would be safer options?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

scenarios.title: C｜素食 / 其他饮食需求
scenarios.setting: 在“提出饮食要求”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“素食 / 其他饮食需求”。

turns.prompt: 你想确认食物是否适合自己的饮食需求，会怎么问？

choices.text: Do you have any vegetarian options?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have any vegetarian options?
feedback.explanation: “vegetarian”指素食的，具体食材仍可继续确认。

choices.text: Which dishes are vegetarian?

feedback.naturalExpression: Which dishes are vegetarian?
feedback.explanation: “vegetarian”指素食的，具体食材仍可继续确认。

choices.text: Is this dish vegetarian?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is this dish vegetarian?
feedback.explanation: “vegetarian”指素食的，具体食材仍可继续确认。

choices.text: Do you have anything without meat or fish?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have anything without meat or fish?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Do you have vegetarian food?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have vegetarian food?
feedback.explanation: 这句正确地问有没有素食；若想知道哪些菜可选，可继续问具体推荐或配料。

turns.text: Yes. The mushroom pasta and vegetable curry are both vegetarian.

turns.prompt: 你想确认菜品是否符合素食需求、能否调整，会怎么说？

choices.text: Does the pasta contain any meat-based stock?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does the pasta contain any meat-based stock?
feedback.explanation: 核实某项内容是否包含在内，能避免双方对配料、配件或费用作不同假设。

choices.text: Can the curry be made vegan?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can the curry be made vegan?
feedback.explanation: “vegan”指不含动物来源成分的，常用于说明饮食要求。

choices.text: Does this contain any dairy?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does this contain any dairy?
feedback.explanation: 核实某项内容是否包含在内，能避免双方对配料、配件或费用作不同假设。

choices.text: Which vegetarian dish would you recommend?

feedback.naturalExpression: Which vegetarian dish would you recommend?
feedback.explanation: “vegetarian”指素食的，具体食材仍可继续确认。

turns.text: The curry can be made vegan if we leave out the yogurt.

turns.prompt: 关于「提出饮食要求」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. I’ll have the vegan version, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll have the vegan version, please.
feedback.explanation: “version”指版本，说明具体版本能避免双方使用不同文件。

choices.text: That sounds good. Could you make it without the yogurt?

feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds good. Could you make it without the yogurt?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I’ll have the mushroom pasta instead.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ll have the mushroom pasta instead.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
